test_read_html_basic: test the read_html function to parse HTML tables into DataFrames
test_read_html_flavors: test read_html with different parser flavors including bs4 lxml and html5lib
test_read_html_match_filter: test read_html with match parameter to filter tables by regex pattern
test_read_html_skiprows: test read_html skiprows parameter with int list set range and slice inputs
test_read_html_index_header: test read_html with index_col and header parameters for column and row selection
test_read_html_parse_dates: test read_html parse_dates parameter to convert string columns to datetime
test_read_html_dtype_backend: test read_html dtype_backend parameter for pyarrow and numpy_nullable backends
test_read_html_multiindex: test read_html with multiindex header and index columns
test_read_html_colspan_rowspan: test read_html handling of HTML colspan and rowspan attributes
test_read_html_extract_links: test read_html extract_links parameter to capture hyperlinks from table cells
test_read_html_displayed_only: test read_html displayed_only parameter to ignore hidden tables
test_read_html_attrs_filter: test read_html attrs parameter to filter tables by HTML attributes
test_read_html_encoding: test read_html with different file encodings including utf-8 latin1 and utf-16
test_read_html_na_values: test read_html na_values and keep_default_na parameters for missing value handling
test_dataframe_to_html: test DataFrame to_html method for HTML serialization and round-trip parsing
